batting.name: DJ Harris
batting.dismissal: run out (V Kohli, J Syed Mohammad)

batting.name: V Kohli
batting.dismissal: c DW Steyn b A Mishra

batting.name: AUK Pathan
batting.dismissal: c DW Steyn b A Mishra

balls.text: smoked! Chargers go past 180, Sanga gets front foot out and clobbers a length ball into the crowd beyond wide long on
cannot connect, too much bounce as he attempts to swing it down the ground, they go for the bye, and make it
feels the need to go over short fine leg, ends up a mile outside off, the ball is just outside off, he cannot get bat on it
Sanga gets four, down the track, making a bit of room and carving a length ball over extra cover
moves across and outside off to pull, bit of a bottom edge goes to deep square
White has given the pull everything, but has only managed to send the top-edge soaring into the sky, bowler settles under it, and holds on as he tumbles to the ground
wide from around the stumps, moving further away from a full length
dropped, Zaheer was in the way of a crunching stroke from Dhawan, got both hands as the rocket came at him, but it popped out
full toss on the pad now, worked to deep midwicket
Zaheer takes punishment this time, slower on a good length, sitting up for White, who clears front leg, and cracks it from outside off, flat and quick over deep midwicket
Zaheer gets away again, Dhawan charges out to a length ball and drills it off the middle of the bat, extra cover manages to stop it
gets the yorker in on middle, even as White makes room, he cannot do anything more than squeezing it out towards point
Zaheer gets away with a full toss on middle and leg, worked wide of deep midwicket
slower length ball, pushed to long off
width given from back of a length, he cannot time it past extra cover
beaten by the bounce as he tries to drive on the up

that was off the middle of the bat, he struggles towards the end at times, but today, he is not, the shuffle works again, ends up outside off, and swings a length ball over short fine leg, into the RCB dugout
pulled wide of long on and White comes back for the second
Dhawan now, shuffles a long way across and drags it from the stumps wide of short fine leg
bring 'em on, White says, stays in the crease, and carves a pitched up ball to the deep extra cover rope, lot of power and superb timing, that was a near-yorker
short now, outside leg, and White pulls it eagerly wide of deep square leg
shot! White has drilled this full delivery over deep midwicket, it was angled in on middle and leg, he stood still, allowed it to come on and lifted it without fuss
pushes a low full toss out to sweeper cover
looks to go for the pull but lets the quite short ball go in the end
full ball pushed to sweeper cover for one
ending on middle from a length, pushed towards extra cover
shot! Dhawan goes over extra cover, hitting the tossed up ball with the turn, and picks up another four
loud appeal for lbw, White hit on the pad with a big turning offbreak, not given, could have been outside the line of off
tries to pick it from outside off and lap it fine on the leg side, manages to get it past the keeper
continues to be back of a length, he dabs it from close to off to short third
White pulls, and mistimes it completely, top-edge swirls and falls well short of the man running across from deep midwicket
worked straight to Zaheer at short fine, who makes a mess of the stop, they are happy with one
back of a length again, and Dhawan gets to his fifty with a charge down the pitch and a swing through midwicket, wide of the man in the deep
width, and Dhawan times the shot as he guides the short of a length ball behind point, too quick for third man
misses as he looks to pull a short of a length ball, misses, the ball almost grazed off stump
goes deep in the crease and again pushes wide of deep midwicket, Mohammad is not happy with the fielders' effort
pushed through on middle, defended to the bowler
pushed softly wide of deep midwicket for a comfortable two
White cranks up, and picks this one from way outside off, and violently mows it high over deep midwicket
swings a flat delivery over square leg, on the bounce to deep square
worked with the angle into him through square leg
for once, Dhawan succeeds with the reverse sweep, this one was just a dab, and he manages to guide the full delivery to the third man rope
worked in front of square leg off the pad
pushed off the front foot to cover
hits a low full toss down to long on
straight to Virat at extra cover
starts off with a flighted one in the blockhole, squeezed out to point
down to long on for one

gone! big mix-up, Harris was halfway up the pitch before he finally decided to turn back, and in the end, had no chance as Virat fired it to the bowler, Dhawan had pushed towards cover and taken a few steps out, Harris had come rushing, but Virat swooped in on the ball, and Harris was out comfortably
slams a tossed up ball down to long off
connects with the reverse sweep now, mishits it to short third man
on a length now, and he cannot get underneath it, pushes it down the groun
smack! he's picked this fullish one up with the angle into him, and swung it over deep midwicket
cannot get the great man away, comes down the pitch but can only push it back to Murali
hit away to sweeper cover
now comes the offbreak, big turn into Harris, he tries to defend, a mile outside the line
pushed down to long off for a single
down the track, but gets too close to the line and pitch of the ball and pushes it to the bowler
looked like the doosra, but shortish, and he is able to drag the pull wide of long on
he gets away with another dot ball, Dhawan slams it straight to extra cover
tries the reverse sweep with the angle going across him, misses
driven down to sweeper cover
charges down the track, the angle takes it away from him, and he ends up mistiming it to long off
angled across and ending on off, Dhawan bends his knees to cut it through point, and comes back just in time for the second
flat and into him, pushed down to long on
pushed to mid-on for a single
lovely, it was the doosra, tossed up fullish outside off, the flight lures him to go for a big drive, but the ball turns away slightly from the bat swing, beaten
drives a flighted ball to long off
fetches a tossed up ball from outside off and slog-sweeps to deep square
slams a fullish delivery to the bowler
turns a full delivery off leg to deep square
beaten on the cut as this one is fired across him
flatter and quicker, from a length, he turns it from the crease to square leg
take that! Dilshan is being clobbered, fullish delivery on off stump, Harris winds up and deposits it over deep midwicket
another boundary, Dilshan turns it down the pads, and Harris swings him wide of short fine
he likes this brand of offspin, uses the turn into him to hammer a length ball from off and middle high over deep midwicket
reaches forward to drive a tossed up full delivery to long off
Harris is beaten for the fourth time in five ball this over, reaches out to drive a widish ball, which did not turn in
turns away sharply from around off, cut to deep point
gets off strike with a forward push in front of cover
beaten for the third time in succession outside off, bounce for Murali
tossed up even more, he reaches out and pushes at it, it was the doosra, so this time Harris ends up pushing inside the line, AB cannot collect the ball, Gayle thought there was an edge
flighted offbreak turning in from well outside off, he ends up driving well outside the line
slices a length ball close to off down to third man
shortish, pulled away to deep square leg
this time he goes leg side and it works, picks up a length ball angled into him and lifts it in front of square leg, well wide of deep square
tries to drive a length ball on the up, mistimes it to mid off
cuts as he sees some width, direct hit from cover and Dhawan was gone, but the throw misses
mistimes an attempted push past extra cover to the fielder
he has been timing some drives pretty well, this one is hit straight to extra cover
swung to deep square leg for one
this time it is shorter in length and he uses the angle to slam it from outside off over square leg, it carries just over a leaping boundary fielder
again he is cramped as he looks to drive a length ball down the ground, straight to Zaheer in his followthrough
is cramped with the angle into him and cannot get much bat on it
gets on top of the short ball and hooks it through square leg even as he weaves away
forced away to extra cover
tries to clobber a length ball through covers, but mistimes it completely, Kohli charges in from cover and lets rip with the throw, direct hit would have been close at the non-striker's
Dhawan gets some width, makes some room as well, and carves this one over point
on to the pads from back of a length, but he gets away with it, Harris can't connect
forces it towards extra cover for one
almost carried to cover, Dhawan driving a pitched up ball hard, did not get it quite off the middle, just fell short of kohli
manages to push one angled into him towards cover and they take the single
stays in the crease and steers a length ball but cannot beat backward point
drops a back of a length ball softly towards point, Dilshan comes running in, lobs the ball towards the stumps, but misses, would have been close had he hit
bangs it in short and going across Harris, who hops and tries to upper cut, cannot reach it
goes hard at a pitched up ball angled across him, mistimes the drive to extra cover
opens the face as he leans forward to run this one to point
tries to force a length ball down the ground but mishits it completely, mid on runs forward to field
leans towards the line of a pitched up ball outside off and pushes it, straight to point
bowls it down the leg side
no beating him this time, he sees it on a good length outside off, a bit of width provided, and he smashes it through cover
Harris is beaten again, this time by Mithun, who bangs it in back of a length and gets bounce and a bit of away movement, Harris pokes at it away from the body
thick edge now as Mithun gets it to angle across him from a length, Dhawan pushes at it, and gets it behind point
shot! too full, on the pads, and Dhawan clips it elegantly through midwicket, that raced away
beats the outside edge now with a nippy length ball that carries across the right-hander who pushes at it from the crease
worked off the pad to fine leg
an inside edge now, Zaheer gets it to comes back in from back of a length, Dhawan goes pushing at the original line, and the inside edge races fine down leg
carries down the leg side with the angle from over the stumps
gets forward and creams a length ball but straight to cover this time
on the pads and tucked away square on the leg side
gets forward and pushes a length ball on middle and leg to midwicket
that will be it, length ball swung to the deep midwicket boundary to make the Chinnaswamy go wild
pushed to sweeper cover to equal the scores
short, pull, six, he was a shade late on it, but that did not matter one bit in the end
they keep disappearing, it does not matter who bowls, clobbered straight down the ground, you got to feel, for the ball
that was Dale Steyn, this is Anand Rajan, and AB de Villiers is in control, down the track, no hint of any desperation, how does he manage it, carves it over extra cover
and for good measure, he calmly drops a furious short ball to third man to keep the strike
it got better, if it could, he has scooped a 142 kph Dale Steyn length ball from two feet outside off over short fine leg

holy moly, incredible, insane, unbelievable, Absolutely Brilliant, it is a 146 kph near-yorker on middle stump, for crying out loud, but AB has made room and clobbered it over extra cover, I refuse to believe it
Steyn tries the slower one, at 118.4 kph, AB clears front leg and slogs it between deep midwicket and long on, no problems again, what have you got, Dale?
Steyn's response is a ripping yorker on middle and leg, AB comfortably works it square on the leg side
Dale Steyn? short ball? what's the fuss about? AB calmly stays in the crease and pulls Steyn for a flat six over deep midwicket
that has to be close, and he's been given, Agarwal's cameo is over, but he's given RCB a chance, looking to swing on the leg side, misses, and is hit in front of middle and leg
hit hard down to long off along the ground
slower one, wide outside off, he cuts it wide of sweeper cover
Agarwal turning it around for RCB, he bends his knee, and carves a pitched up ball high in the air, it carries over the deep extra cover rope, clean effective hitting
now AB with the reverse hit to a medium-pacer, connects well and places it just wide of  backward point
they have more than the required runs for the over, Agarwal has creamed this length ball with the angle wide of deep midwicket
Agarwal gets one away, over long off, not sure he was looking to go that direction as he cleared front leg, and drilled the length ball, bit of a leading edge but he gets maximum for the effort
loses his bat as he charges out, but only after he has hit the length ball to extra cover, lets the bat be and completes the single
tries to slog a pitched up ball, mishit to midwicket
goes after a wide one outside off, misses
Dilshan loses his stumps now, Chargers on top, Dilshan was looking to go square on the leg side again, missed the full delivery, and two stumps are uprooted
low full toss, on the pads, poor bowling, Dilshan happily swings it wide of deep midwicket
pushed to extra cover, White has found the stumps, this could be tight, Dilshan seems to be in after backing up, just by a frame though when the bails come off
cuts a slow length ball on the bounce to short third man, there was a chance for an overthrow, but AB had run far too much for the single
way too wide outside off stump
pushed down to long on
high full toss, he tries to go after it but was late on the swing, mishits it to extra cover, Dilshan did not ground his bat at the non-striker's, had the throw from White hit, he was gone
works a back of a length ball square on leg
tries to hit a length ball with the angle off the pad, cannot connect, the ball rolls towards point
they still go after Mishra, mistimes a big cover drive for a single

Steyn at it again, Mishra has another wicket, tossed up legbreak, drawing the batsman out, luring him into a big stroke, the ball turns away sharply, and swirls high off the mishit only to settle into the safe hands of you-know-who
googly, he cannot pull it away
hit hard through point for a couple

forget Steyn the bowler, they'll have to contend with Steyn the fielder as well, Virat absolutely smoked this full delivery with the turn, it was headed for six, before Steyn decided to get in the way at wide long off, timing his leap to pluck a stunner, Virat was shocked, he did not move for some time
punched straight to point
that kept low, he has been bowling those slower ones regularly, this one was closer to off, and he is beaten on the cut
another slow and wide one, cracked away to sweeper cover
this time he connects, swings it from a good length on off behind square leg
slower wide length ball, he waits and tries to hammer it through extra cover, still to early on the stroke, and beaten
nearly edged it to the keeper as he looked to steer it to third man
beaten on the cut off a quick and flat delivery
punched down to long off
could have out twice, charged out and swung wildly, the ball almost carried to short third man, a better throw from there could have caught Dilshan short at the non-striker's
drives hard down to long off
the googly almost gets him, he went for the cut even as it spun in, had walked out of the crease after inside edging it, Parthiv was a shade late in gathering it, could have been a stumping
beaten on the cut by the bounce on this widish one
worked through square leg for an easy two
oh well, Gayle is bowled this time, he jumped out of the crease looking to go big again, this ball was much fuller, almost yorker length, and Gayle misses, only to lose his stumps
there he goes, length delivery, Gayle has let many of them go unpunished today, this one is not so fortunate, and he winds up to clobber it high over wide long on
length ball far too wide down leg
mishits a length ball to mid off
misses as he looks to cut
the angle does not work for Mishra, Gayle brings up his 100th six in the IPL with a calm swing over deep square leg
ball stays low as he makes room to cut, past a diving point
mistimes the pull to long on
whipped from outside off down to long on
backs away to one on off to cut, straight to point
drives a very full tossed up ball to extra cover
would have been wide had he not reached out to cut it, a dive by sweeper cover parries the ball towards the rope, he gets up, runs after it and slides again to haul it back
this time he gets the cut past point, sweeper is there in the deep
appeal for caught behind off an attempted reverse sweep, Dilshan swung hard but could not connect, umpire Dharmasena shakes his head, no bat there
slower one cut to point, Gayle has to get  back as the throw comes in
he walked towards the line of the wide delivery but let it go in the end
full ball squeezed out to third man
cuts a widish length ball, but backward point stops it to this left
backs away to a length ball to cut to deep point
flighted googly, he waits on it and pushes to long off
goes back to a tossed up length ball and manages to hit it to deep midwicket
Mishra drops it short, and pays for it, Dilshan opens up and hammers the pull through midwicket to reach his fifty
lots of turn from a length, but wide outside off, and he reaches out to slap it past cover
full on leg, worked with the spin to midwicket
slower one, there was width available, but he cuts it to short third man
he is doing all the scoring at the moment, fetched from outside off, and swept for a flat six over deep square leg
Dilshan ends the succession of dot balls with a loft over mid off, who cannot save the four with a slide
forced back to the bowler
looks to hit it through cover, gets an inside edge
full delivery pushed to midwicket
poor ball, really, with no fine leg, no short fine leg, he bowls it full on the pads, and Gayle helps himself to a flicked four
beaten outside off as he tries to guide a widish pitched up ball
Gayle wants some runs, he opens up, stands with feet wide apart but finds square leg as he has a go
mistimes the pull as he charges out, away to deep square
Dilshan gets down on his knee and gets enough bat on the Dilscoop to send the length ball wide of the keeper down leg
wide, back of a length, but he can only get one as there is sweeper cover
slaps a length ball to cover for one
into the pads, Dilshan cannot work it away, ball rolls towards point
stays in the crease to a back of a length widish one, but cannot steer it past short third man
Dilshan doing the early running for RCB, skips out, takes it on the half volley, and hammers it over the bowler
opens up and forces a back of a length ball wide of mid on
very full on the stumps, squeezed out past the bowler, mid on cannot stop it cleanly
a maiden, to Chris Gayle, the third bouncer on the trot, Gayle has nothing to do with it, down he goes under it, corker of an over from Steyn
and another one, the slower bouncer now, right on target, at Gayle's head, he goes down under it again
ripper of a bouncer at 143.1 kph, Gayle does the wise thing, he ducks, just in time
Gayle has had enough, he makes room and charges out to have a go at Steyn, cannot connect with a 149 kph delivery
short, rears up at Gayle, who does well to drop it softly towards point
good length on middle and leg, Gayle quietly defends
smacks the drive straight to extra cover now
oh dear, that was just a push, nothing more, but Sanga failed to cut it off as he ran across from mid off, and then ended up escorting it to the boundary
hurried into a defensive push as the ball straightens on middle and leg, gets it in front of square leg
driven straight off the front foot, mid off gets across to cut it off
defends a length ball around off towards point, and off they go, Dilshan makes his ground with a dive
full into the pads, Dilshan works it down to mid on and they go through for a quick single
Steyn is dropping it shortish and Dilshan is in the mood to pull, gets it off the bottom edge towards midwicket
a shade late in getting the bat down to push to mid on, Gayle trots out for the single, but it sent back late, just manages to make it back
good reply from Dilshan, Steyn hurls it in shorter, into Dilshan, who swivels and hooks it past short fine leg
tries to go for the pull, but is beaten by pace and takes it on the thigh pad
back of a length, Dilshan uses the pace and angle into him to work it in front of square
quick, full and on the stumps at 139.1 kph, Dilshan drives it well, to mid on
swept from outside off again, but this time Anand Rajan puts in a sliding stop at deep square leg to save what would have been the third four
more runs, Dilshan fetches it from outside off now, and slams it over square leg
just short of a length, and turning into Dilshan, who swivels and swings it over backward square leg
tosses it up, Gayle only pushes it down to long off
worked to deep midwicket, Dilshan wanted two, he had to get back
squeezed out to short third man
